name: jev
description: Jev decision layer: safety guard, sparse cached worker routing, advisory failure/report triage, opt-in discovery advice, lossless compression and advisory context-boundary reports under host context pressure. Six tools: jev_decide, jev_select, jev_status, jev_verify, jev_evidence and jev_diagnose (supplied hypotheses/checks only). Explicit economy preset, optional API budgets and local explain diagnostics; no execution authority or net-savings claim.

config.description: Host-owned: the session's trusted project root (nearest .git/.synaps-project). The guard's 'leaves workspace' question is asked relative to this, not to the plugin directory.

TypeSafe API key. Easiest: run `/jev key <apikey_…>` inside synaps (validates, saves to plugins/jev/config, activates without restart). Also resolved from TYPESAFE_API_KEY or extension.jev.api_key. Without it the plugin loads inert and re-checks every 5 s.
Model name or alias. Pin a versioned id (e.g. jev-1.13.0) once thresholds are tuned.
Per-request HTTP timeout. Must stay under the runtime's 5 s fail-open hook timeout.
JSONL audit trail (relative to SYNAPS_BASE_DIR). Contains command text and file paths; chmod 600. Empty disables.
Enable the before_tool_call safety gate.
Comma-separated runtime tool names the guard evaluates.
Risk score (0–3) at/above which the user is asked to confirm.
Risk score (0–3) at/above which the call is hard-blocked. 3.5 = never.
Below this confidence the guard always asks rather than guesses.
Probability that the call touches secrets at/above which it always asks.
Probability that the call writes outside cwd//tmp at/above which it always asks.
Fill omitted subagent role / write_policy (and model, if router_models is set) from the task text.
Minimum Jev confidence to fill a routing field.
needs_write probability at/below which an omitted write_policy becomes read_only.

Optional tier map, e.g. "small=anthropic/claude-haiku-4-5,medium=anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6". Ids must already be authorised for workers (see subagent_models). Unset = never change model; frontier always inherits.
Opt-in bounded reversible identical-line runs for bash output. Off by default, independent of guard; never on failures.
Compression presentation mode: jev (remote readability decision) or deterministic (local bounded lossless checks only). Does not enable compression.
Comma-separated tools intersected with bash only; other tools are never compressed.
Minimum raw UTF-8 bytes; integer clamped to 6000..262144, invalid uses 6000.
Finite readability-choice confidence in 0.85..1; invalid uses 0.85.
Deprecated and ignored; no output is sampled or dropped.
Deprecated and ignored; no output is sampled or dropped.
Automatic advisory-only bash failure triage; independent of guard. Off skips calls. No execution or retry.
Opt-in discovery advice; sends redacted query/descriptors to Jev (API cost). Independent of guard; never activation/permission.
Enable explicit jev_verify optional-check priority advice, independent of guard. Never skip authority or test execution.
Opt-in explicit descriptor relevance advice independent of guard. No source access or trust certification.
Opt-in automatic worker-report triage, independent of guard. Sends redacted worker prose, not artifacts; unverified advisory only, no lifecycle changes.
Opt-in optional API session budgets/circuit; guard and user-authorized probes/self-test excluded.
Optional session calls; finite range 1 to 1000000; integer.
Optional session cost_usd; finite range 1e-06 to 1000. Input-only estimated cost, not a hard dollar cap.
Optional session latency_ms; finite range 1 to 86400000; integer.
Optional session error_streak; finite range 1 to 1000; integer.
Optional session cooldown_s; finite range 0.001 to 86400.
Opt-in jev_diagnose supplied hypotheses/checks only; independent of guard. No cache, fixes, execution or approval.

Advisory task-boundary reports (context_phase new_task) only when the host reports context band pressure at a tool-free turn end. Sends redacted final assistant text and latest request; no authority to roll context over. Inert on hosts without context_management.

commands.name: jev
commands.description: Jev decision layer: `/jev key <apikey_…>` validates+saves+activates a key without restart; `/jev status`; `/jev test`; `/jev guard|router|compress|triage|discovery|verification|evidence|diagnosis|reports|context on|off [--save]` flips one feature (session-only unless --save); `/jev off|on [--save]` flips all ten (including opt-in discovery, verification, evidence, diagnosis, reports and context). `/jev economy [--save]`: guard unchanged, router/triage/context on, deterministic compression, optional advice off; no savings claim. `/jev compress mode jev|deterministic [--save]` chooses mode; all-on leaves it unchanged. `/jev budget` shows optional budgets; `/jev explain [clear]` shows fixed local diagnostics (clear only the last-64 process ring, not accounting).
